contract.latency_definition: per-question local retrieval wall time; Chroma includes local query embedding and vector query, BM25 includes lexical scoring/ranking, Hybrid includes both plus RRF fusion

metric_formulas.hit_at_k: 1 if any reference_context_id occurs in first k results else 0
metric_formulas.mrr: 1 / rank of first gold result, else 0
metric_formulas.recall_at_k: gold IDs in first k / number of gold IDs
metric_formulas.precision_at_k: gold IDs in first k / number of returned IDs in first k
metric_formulas.ragas_id_context_recall: gold IDs in Top-10 / number of gold IDs

contract.multi_gold_policy: A hit requires any gold; recall counts all unique gold IDs; precision uses literal k.
contract.aggregate_policy: Only expected_answerable=true and needs_human_review=false cases enter IR/RAGAS means.
contract.negative_policy: Excluded from IR/RAGAS; reported as score-distribution diagnostics only.
contract.preprocessing: Same raw question; each baseline uses only its native local scoring path.
